title: ZeroDesk
summary: Control your Cardputer from a browser: screen, keyboard, shell, files and apps
description: Open ZeroDesk and it shows an address and a one-time pairing code. Enter them in a browser on the same network to get the Cardputer's live screen with a working copy of its keyboard (plus paste, screenshots and recordings), a shell, a file browser, app installs from the store, and CPU, memory, battery and network stats. HTTPS and local network only; runs as your user; installing apps asks for your password. Remote typing needs one reboot after the first install.
